_source.method: All values are copied from the named source files, parsed by scripts/build.py in the session scratchpad; the only arithmetic is kg->kt division, EU28 minus UK for crude steel 2005-2015, and the stated cross-check conversions. PRODCOM EU27_2020 aggregates are rounded where flagged ":R" (value +/- rounding base) and estimated where ":E". AI-compiled - pending Secretariat verification.

inventory_attempt.unfccc: https://unfccc.int/ghg-inventories-annex-i-parties/2025 (EU row: CRT https://unfccc.int/documents/646514) loaded once (200, 294 kB); subsequent requests to unfccc.int (/2026 page, /documents/646514) and di.unfccc.int returned 200 with a 212-byte Incapsula JavaScript challenge, not data.
inventory_attempt.eea: https://www.eea.europa.eu/en/analysis/publications/annual-european-union-greenhouse-gas-inventory-2026 reachable; only the NID PDF is offered (https://www.eea.europa.eu/en/analysis/publications/2026-unfccc-submission-of-the-eu-ghg-inventory-report-under-the-paris-agreement-1990-2024/eu-nid-2026_final.pdf/@@download/file, 549 pp.). It has no activity-data time series; Table 4.34 gives 2024 gap-filled AD (see inventory_anchors_2024).
inventory_attempt.eea_sdi: sdi.eea.europa.eu catalogue: connection reset through the proxy.

_source.not_reached_or_not_used: CEPI (membership not EU27), European Aluminium (charts without data), Eurostat DS-059368 (CPA 2.2, 2025 only), UNFCCC CRT (bot challenge).

inventory_anchors_2024._note: EU NID 2026 (EEA, eu-nid-2026_final.pdf) section 4.4.2, Table 4.34 "Documentation of gap filling of activity data", PDF pp. 340-341. Only 2024 is gap-filled in the EU CRT; section 1.7.6.2 states the EU cannot complete the sectoral background tables because Member States use different types of activity data and some are confidential.

crude_steel.flags: 2005-2015 is a derived EU27: worldsteel publishes EU(28) and the United Kingdom; EU27_2020 = EU(28) - UK (Croatia included in EU(28) rows for all years). Splice check 2016-2019 (worldsteel EU28-UK vs Eurofer EU27): {"2016": 0.15, "2017": 0.06, "2018": -0.13, "2019": -0.26} per cent.

pig_iron.source: Eurostat PRODCOM DS-059359 Total production, APRODQNT
pig_iron.flags: EU totals rounded for confidentiality (":R"); value lies within value +/- rounding base (up to 7 Mt in 2007). Secondary series; worldsteel/Eurofer pig iron not extracted.

cement.source: CEMBUREAU Key facts & figures, chart "Cement Production And Consumption EU 27 & Cement Europe 2000-2024", dataset "PRODUCTION EU27"
cement.flags: Cement, not clinker. Unit not stated on the chart; tonnes inferred from magnitude (2005 = 239.5 million). 2001-2004 values carry decimals, indicating estimation; 2005-2024 are integers. Falling clinker-to-cement ratio means cement understates the fall in clinker (the CO2-relevant product). Whether "EU 27" is EU27_2020 for all years is not stated.

lime_quicklime_sold.source: Eurostat PRODCOM DS-059358 Sold production, PRODQNT
lime_quicklime_sold.flags: SOLD production only: excludes captive lime (steel, sugar, pulp); no total-production series exists for lime codes. Rounded +/- 2 Mt in 2021, 2022 and 2024. Inventory 2.A.2 gap-filled EU activity 2024 = 19 385 kt vs 16 000 kt here.

ammonia.source: Eurostat PRODCOM DS-059359 Total production, APRODQNT
ammonia.flags: Total production. Inventory cross-check 2024: 9 488 kt N x 17.031/14.007 = 11 537 kt NH3 vs EU NID 2026 Table 4.34 gap-filled 11 371 kt (+1.5 %).

nitric_acid.source: Eurostat PRODCOM DS-059359 Total production, APRODQNT
nitric_acid.flags: Total production in nitrogen content. Cross-check 2024: 4 281 kt N x 63.01/14.007 = 19 256 kt HNO3 vs NID 2026 Table 4.34 gap-filled 15 200 kt (+27 %): definitions differ (PRODCOM includes sulphonitric acids; inventory AD may be 100 % HNO3 for N2O-emitting plants only). Use for trend with caution.

adipic_acid.source: Eurostat PRODCOM DS-059359 Total production, APRODQNT
adipic_acid.locator: PRODCOM 20143385 "Adipic acid; its salts and esters", unit ['KG']
adipic_acid.flags: Total production of adipic acid, its salts and esters. Heavily rounded for confidentiality (few EU producers): rounding base 50-300 kt on a 450-1000 kt series, so year-to-year changes are mostly noise.

ethylene.source: Eurostat PRODCOM DS-059359 Total production, APRODQNT

aluminium_unwrought_nonalloy.source: Eurostat PRODCOM DS-059359 Total production, APRODQNT
aluminium_unwrought_nonalloy.locator: PRODCOM 24421130 "Unwrought non-alloy aluminium (excluding powders and flakes)"
aluminium_unwrought_nonalloy.flags: PROXY ONLY, not primary aluminium: non-alloy unwrought metal from smelters and remelters; smelter output cast as primary alloys is excluded. No primary-aluminium tonnage series for EU27 2005-2024 was reachable (inventory CRT blocked; European Aluminium charts carry no machine-readable data).

aluminium_primary_alloys_unwrought.source: Eurostat PRODCOM DS-059359 Total production, APRODQNT
aluminium_primary_alloys_unwrought.locator: PRODCOM 24421153 "Unwrought aluminium alloys in primary form (excluding aluminium powders and flakes)"
aluminium_primary_alloys_unwrought.flags: Code discontinued after 2012 (merged into 24421154 primary+secondary alloys), so 24421130+24421153 approximates smelter output only for 2005-2012.

clinker_prodcom.source: Eurostat PRODCOM DS-059359 Total production, 23511100 Cement clinker
clinker_prodcom.reason: Do not use. Starts 2009; 2024 EU27 = 83 303 kt vs 113 723 kt EU inventory gap-filled clinker (NID 2026 Table 4.34), i.e. 27 % short; country rows are implausible (France 1 548 kt in 2024, Austria under 100 kt, Czechia and Portugal missing 2021-2024), and the EU total falls 28 % from 2019 to 2024, a fall the inventory level check above does not support.

clinker_prodcom_sold.reason: Merchant clinker only (12-20 Mt), not production.

crude_steel_prodcom.reason: EU totals rounded with bases up to 40 000 kt (EAF non-alloy 2019-2021) and the 2024 sum of the six codes (156 Mt) is 21 % above Eurofer (129.6 Mt). Not used.

Iron and steel.note: Crude steel, worldsteel/Eurofer. Pig iron (PRODCOM, rounded) is an alternative denominator for the BF-BOF share that carries most 2.C.1 emissions.

Non-metallic minerals.note: No consistent EU27 clinker series 2005-2024 was obtainable: EU CRT unreachable and only 2024 is gap-filled; PRODCOM clinker rejected. Cement (CEMBUREAU) used as proxy, flagged; lime (sold quicklime) available separately; glass not assembled (PRODCOM glass codes mix m2 and kg). Clinker+lime+glass sum therefore not built.

Chemicals.note: No meaningful tonne aggregate: the products differ by orders of magnitude in emission per tonne (adipic acid N2O vs ethylene), and 1.A.2.c fuel combustion covers thousands of products. A raw tonne sum would be ~95 % ethylene plus ammonia and would mis-state intensity. Defensible options: (a) keep the C20 value index for 1.A.2.c and use product tonnes only for the matching 2.B process categories (2.B.1 ammonia, 2.B.2 nitric, 2.B.3 adipic, 2.B.8 ethylene as petrochemical proxy); or (b) a fixed-weight physical index with 2005 inventory emissions per subcategory as weights.

Non-ferrous metals.note: No primary-aluminium tonnage for EU27 2005-2024 found; PRODCOM non-alloy unwrought aluminium is a partial proxy. Keep the C24.4 index or obtain European Aluminium / IAI data.

Pulp and paper.note: FAOSTAT EU27 paper and paperboard; wood pulp also given.

Food and drink.note: Out of scope; keep production index.

Other industry.note: Out of scope; keep production index.
